scope: Transactional DXF HATCH boundary-loop creation and count parsing for boundary edges, polyline vertices, pattern dash arrays, pattern lines, gradient stops, and seed points. Evidence is generated in-memory and does not qualify DWG HATCH support or native application semantics.
changes: HATCH loop (91), pattern dash (79), polyline vertex (93), edge (93), and gradient-stop (453) counts reserve storage and validate existing prefixes before committing expected-count state.
HATCH pattern line count (78) is validated against previously parsed lines before updating its expected-count state, so a corrected same-group retry remains possible.
HATCH seed-point count (98) reserves before clearing transient parser state or publishing the count; each seed coordinate also reserves before append when necessary.
HATCH boundary-loop (92) construction allocates the loop, optional polyline, and destination capacity before publishing the loop or changing parser state.
HATCH boundary-edge (72) construction reserves and allocates the selected line, arc, ellipse, or spline before appending it and publishing the active parser pointer.
HATCH coordinate-pair cursor changes are committed only after successful group parsing; polyline vertex reserve/object failures leave group 10 eligible for exact retry.
HATCH gradient-stop (463) reserve and append complete before recording that the stop field has been observed.
Reject declared counts smaller than already parsed loop, edge, vertex, dash, or seed prefixes.

allocationFailureCoverage.retry: After injected reserve failure or invalid count, resend the same group and verify state acceptance and subsequent data parsing.
